name: xiphos
_note: Xiphos (Milos Tatarevic) is a UCI engine in C with a handcrafted eval. Perft is invoked via the top-level command `perft <depth>` (NOT `go perft`). Output is a single summary line: `perft(N)=NODES, time: Tms, nps: V (no hashing, bulk counting)`. Threads + Hash setoption supported, though the perft routine doesn't itself use the TT or extra threads. Bin name varies by build target — the install script symlinks the produced `xiphos-<flavour>` to bin/xiphos/xiphos.
